key.name: enabled
key.description: Captions under the speech this computer plays, made on this computer from the sound output while an app plays. They need the speech model `ame desktop captions on` fetches; without it the key does nothing. Off as the image ships.

key.name: language
key.summary: The language captions and dictation hear
key.description: Each language has a speech model of its own, which `ame desktop captions language` fetches once when it is chosen; without its model, captions and dictation do nothing.

key.name: dictation
key.description: While on, the shortcut listens to the microphone and types what is said into the text field in use, made on this computer by the captions' recognizer. Off as the image ships, and its shortcut is not bound.

key.name: dictate
key.description: Bound only while dictation is on.
